protocol.calibration: source 2 L ring kLa and author-calculated power summaries; Pichia10 L Table2
protocol.holdout: all receiving kLa, power and operating settings; Pichia100/1000 L Table2 outcomes
protocol.source_memory_limit: Published literature could be present in model pretraining. Blinded filesystem access does not establish absence of prior knowledge.
protocol.analyst_blinding: The published sources were inspected to construct this benchmark. Holdout means excluded from parameter fitting and agent inputs; it is not a claim of analyst blinding or prospective validation.
protocol.randomness: Deterministic algebra and exhaustive declared candidate grid; no stochastic solver.

manual_workflow: Check nominal versus working volume and units
Transcribe source measurements with exact locations
Build receiver equipment profiles and flag missing ratings
Separate calibration from receiving evaluation outcomes
Run matched physical scenarios and record assumptions
Review applicability, discrepancies, economics and follow-up experiments
